title: Нумерация строк
description:
Дана таблица `employees(id, name, department, salary)`. Напишите запрос, который нумерует сотрудников от 1 по **убыванию зарплаты** (`rn`), при одинаковой зарплате — по имени. Отсортируйте по `rn`.

```sql
SELECT name, salary, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY salary DESC, name) AS rn FROM employees ORDER BY rn;
```

examples.input: SELECT name, salary, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY salary DESC, name) AS rn FROM employees ORDER BY rn;

constraints: ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY salary DESC, name)
hints: ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY salary DESC, name)
